$comment: Revolutions (domain/revolutions/spec.md): revolutions/generated/runtime/*.json plus reference.yaml and the balance values of revolutions-design.md section 7 and 12. All numbers are placeholders.

lord_measures.land_share: Share (0-1) of the realm's provinces held by lords rather than run by your officials.
lord_measures.wavering_or_worse: Number of lords whose loyalty is Wavering, Disloyal or In revolt.
lord_measures.disloyal_or_worse: Number of lords whose loyalty is Disloyal or In revolt.

stances.lead: Lead it: apply the revolution's regime yourself, now. The old order may rise against you instead.
stances.bend: Bend: grant part of it. A smaller regime, and the signs ease; it can come back if they return.
stances.fight: Fight it: the revolution becomes a great revolt. Its result decides the regime.
stances.path: Not the ruler's choice: which way the revolution itself goes (chosen by its own leaders, or rolled).

actions.grant_fief: Grant royal provinces to a new lord (country stats 5.3).
actions.sell_title: Sell a province to a rich merchant as a fief (country stats 5.3).
actions.seize_land: Take a lord's land by decree (country stats 5.4).
actions.call_the_lords: Call lords and their retinues to war (warfare 3.2).
actions.crushing_taxes: Set a province's tax rate to crushing (province stats 8).
actions.persecute: Apply a persecution policy to a faith (religion design).

generals_switch_to.$comment: revolutions-design 7: a winning general can switch the regime (changes-for-other-designs Warfare).

card.$comment: revolutions-design 1: the card fits a phone width of about 40 characters.

camp_rules.$comment: families.yaml camps.*.lords and camps.*.army lines, transcribed as rules. Loyalty steps: loyal < wavering < disloyal < in_revolt.

regime_on_apply.$comment: regimes.yaml risk lines that act at once.

faith.name: Faith revolutions
faith.idea: A religious movement takes power and turns its community into the state.

revolution.lords: Lords of the movement's faith who are Wavering or worse
revolution.army: Soldiers of the movement's faith desert at 5 % a month

old_order.lords: Lords of other faiths, and every Loyal lord

estates.name: Estates and town revolutions
estates.idea: Towns, assemblies or great lords force the crown to share power, or lose it.

revolution.lords: Disloyal lords join with their retinues
revolution.army: Unpaid soldiers desert at 5 % a month

liberal_national.name: Liberal and national revolutions
liberal_national.idea: Townsfolk and scholars demand a constitution, a nation, or a republic.

revolution.lords: Few: only Disloyal lords with the Ambitious trait
revolution.army: Conscripted soldiers desert at 5 % a month while war weariness is high

freedom.name: Freedom revolutions
freedom.idea: Enslaved and colonised people overthrow those who hold them.

revolution.note: On plantation tiles the farmers are the enslaved workers (event tree population group enslaved_africans); they join at 30 %.
revolution.lords: None
revolution.army: Colonial troops of the same people desert at 10 % a month

agrarian.name: Peasant and agrarian revolutions
agrarian.idea: Farmers rise against lords, tax collectors or a dynasty that has lost the right to rule.

revolution.lords: Only lords in revolt
revolution.army: Soldiers from farming provinces desert at 5 % a month while Hungry

stance_labels.bend: Cut taxes and open the granaries

wave.note: Spreads as Neighbour in revolt grievances (rebellions 4.2), not as an ideology.

from_above.name: Revolutions from above
from_above.idea: The ruler turns the realm over from the top, and the old order fights back.

revolution.note: Nobody rises for it: the ruler starts it as a decision.

old_order.lords: Every Disloyal lord, and Wavering lords with the Pious or Proud trait

homeland.name: Homeland revolutions
homeland.idea: A region's own warriors throw off a distant empire and crown their own ruler.

revolution.lords: Lords of the region's culture who are Wavering or worse
revolution.army: Soldiers from the region desert at 5 % a month

old_order.lords: Lords of other cultures, and every Loyal lord

stance_labels.lead: Grant the region its own crown

wave.note: Spreads as Foreign rule grievances in neighbouring provinces held by distant empires.

socialist_defeat.name: Revolutions of war and want
socialist_defeat.idea: A lost war, hunger in the towns and new socialist ideas bring down the old regime.

revolution.lords: None
revolution.army: Soldiers mutiny at 10 % a month while war weariness is above 14

restoration.name: Restorations
restoration.idea: The old dynasty comes back after a revolution, but cannot undo all of it.

revolution.lords: Émigré lords and Loyal lords of the old house

old_order.lords: Lords and officials who gained land or office under the revolution

league_of_the_faithful.name: League of the faithful
league_of_the_faithful.lords: Temple elders replace the lords. Each lord's province passes to the nearest temple of the movement; the elder runs it like a lord but never defects to another country.
league_of_the_faithful.church: Temples of the movement own one farm tile in each province they run.
league_of_the_faithful.faith: The movement's faith becomes the state faith. Chaplain effects are doubled.
league_of_the_faithful.levy: The faithful answer a call to arms: every class of the state faith can be levied, at the farmers' share.
league_of_the_faithful.land: Tax from temple provinces is light and cannot be raised.
league_of_the_faithful.abroad: Lords of neighbouring countries fear the example: their opinion of you -30.
league_of_the_faithful.risk: With no single ruler, wars of conquest need half the temple elders to agree.
league_of_the_faithful.loop: You govern through temples, not lords: cheap, loyal provinces that pay little and fight hard for the faith.

qizilbash_order.name: Order state
qizilbash_order.form_note: After three reigns of one family the form may reform to household_realm (government 6.4).
qizilbash_order.lords: Clan chiefs of the order become lords with large retinues. Their loyalty rests on faith in the ruler, not gifts: it drops a step each time the ruler loses a battle they lead.
qizilbash_order.faith: The order's faith becomes the state faith; conversion by decree is open (religion design).
qizilbash_order.levy: Chiefs' retinues are horse archers and count double in the lords' call.
qizilbash_order.abroad: Countries of the other branch of the faith get a holy-war reason against you (diplomacy design).
qizilbash_order.risk: A defeat in a battle the ruler leads makes every chief waver.
qizilbash_order.loop: Holy-warrior chiefs give you a strong army early, but their faith in the ruler is your stability.

reformist_caliphate.name: Reformist caliphate
reformist_caliphate.form_note: Every governor holds a service grant (government 3.3): the land returns at his death.
reformist_caliphate.lords: Lords become appointed governors (emirs). When one dies, the land does not pass to an heir: it returns to you and you appoint a new governor.
reformist_caliphate.church: Mosque schools train judges: judges cost half.
reformist_caliphate.faith: Wrong faith counts as two grievances outside the state faith's provinces until they convert.
reformist_caliphate.abroad: Rulers of the same faith who did not join get a reason to resist; reformers abroad gain 0.05 support.
reformist_caliphate.risk: Appointed governors far from the capital drift toward independence after 30 years.
reformist_caliphate.loop: Lords never found dynasties, so a large realm stays yours, but each death means a new appointment.

heavenly_kingdom.name: Heavenly kingdom
heavenly_kingdom.lords: Abolished. Their land goes to a common treasury.
heavenly_kingdom.faith: The movement's faith is imposed; other houses of worship are closed (their clergy become homeless).
heavenly_kingdom.land: Food above each family's need goes to the sacred treasury each harvest, so castle stores fill fast.
heavenly_kingdom.towns: Market folk slots halve: private trade is restricted.
heavenly_kingdom.abroad: Every neighbour of another faith: opinion -50.
heavenly_kingdom.risk: Leaders quarrel: each decade a roll may split the realm between two leaders (a pretender rising).
heavenly_kingdom.loop: Food is no longer your limit, but trade and faith become your weak points.

mahdiyya.name: The Mahdist state
mahdiyya.lords: Tribal chiefs become emirs of the Ansar banners. The ruler may move whole tribes to the capital to keep them close.
mahdiyya.church: The old law books are burned: the Mahdi's rulings replace the law schools.
mahdiyya.faith: Wrong faith for every other teaching, Sufi orders of other paths included.
mahdiyya.levy: Every believer can be called to the banners.
mahdiyya.trade: Trade with the old ruler's lands is closed; caravans pay the treasury only.
mahdiyya.abroad: The old ruler and its overlord: opinion -50 and a reason to fight for 20 years.
mahdiyya.risk: The Mahdi may die within a few years (a roll each year); a successor must face the Mahdi's kinsmen as pretenders. Moving tribes empties farmland: famine risk doubles.
mahdiyya.loop: A holy army without equal in numbers but with old weapons: you win by masses and faith, and lose to guns.

town_league.name: League of towns
town_league.lords: Kept, but they cannot take a town's land.
town_league.towns: Every town gets a town law charter. Towns lend money cheaply.
town_league.land: Raising a tax rate needs the towns' consent (an assembly vote).
town_league.abroad: Other crowns with restless towns: opinion -20.
town_league.risk: Towns refuse wars far from home.
town_league.loop: Your gold comes from loans and consent, not decree; towns grow fast.

estates_republic.name: Republic of the estates
estates_republic.lords: Become merchant houses: same card, but their wants are trade cities, ships and monopolies, and they lend you money.
estates_republic.trade: Merchants +2; a chartered company can be founded (company design).
estates_republic.levy: Small levy; paid companies are cheaper by a quarter.
estates_republic.abroad: Trade cities and other republics: opinion +20.
estates_republic.risk: A war commander from the leading house may try to make the office hereditary (a stadholder event).
estates_republic.loop: You fight with money: loans, paid companies and fleets instead of levies.

commonwealth.name: Commonwealth of the army
commonwealth.lords: Lords who fought for the king lose their land to the state; the rest keep it but lose any office.
commonwealth.church: Bishops' lands are sold; the minority sects of the state faith get tolerance.
commonwealth.levy: A standing army trained to one model: standing regiments cost a third less and train faster (recruiting 4.5).
commonwealth.abroad: Monarchies: opinion -40; a counter-revolution reason to fight you for 20 years.
commonwealth.risk: Generals who grow too big (warfare 4.6) are twice as likely; a successful one becomes Protector and the regime becomes court_absolutism or restored_monarchy.
commonwealth.loop: The army is your government: strong and cheap to keep, but it can take power.

crown_and_assembly.name: Crown and assembly
crown_and_assembly.lords: Kept. Seizing a lord's land needs a trial before the assembly.
crown_and_assembly.trade: Public debt: interest halved, the loan limit doubled.
crown_and_assembly.land: Raising any tax rate, and declaring a war of conquest, need an assembly vote.
crown_and_assembly.abroad: Countries that hold the same regime: opinion +15.
crown_and_assembly.risk: If the assembly refuses three votes in ten years, the ruler may try a coup (a reaction spark).
crown_and_assembly.loop: Every big decision needs consent, and in return money is cheap and the realm is steady.

court_absolutism.name: Absolute monarchy at court
court_absolutism.lords: Lords are drawn to court: their retinues halve, their loyalty falls half as fast, and seizing land makes the others waver one step less.
court_absolutism.land: Intendants: your officials may be sent into lords' provinces as overseers.
court_absolutism.risk: A child ruler or a long regency undoes it: lords leave court (a lords' rising spark).
court_absolutism.loop: You win the long game against the lords: fewer retinues, more officials, a richer court.

princes_compact.name: Compact of the princes
princes_compact.lords: The great lords win: each gets his want, and none can be tried or seized from for 30 years.
princes_compact.abroad: Rivals may bribe your lords at half price.
princes_compact.risk: Lords' retinues outgrow yours; any new crisis is a lords' rising.
princes_compact.loop: The realm is run for the lords: you rule by bargaining with them.

federal_republic.name: Federal republic
federal_republic.lords: There are none: land belongs to farming families and market folk.
federal_republic.land: Each province elects its own official, free of wages, with a random type.
federal_republic.levy: Militia: farmers can be levied for defence at no gold cost; a standing army needs an assembly vote.
federal_republic.abroad: Old colonial powers: opinion -20 for 20 years.
federal_republic.risk: Provinces with different trade goods can quarrel: a separatist sign if one region's wares make up most of the income.
federal_republic.loop: Cheap, self-run provinces and fast settlement, but a weak centre in war.

revolutionary_republic.name: Revolutionary republic
revolutionary_republic.lords: Abolished. Their land returns to the state; the lords go abroad as pretenders (province stats 10.1) and pay rivals to fight you.
revolutionary_republic.church: Church land is seized and sold; house-of-worship slots halve, and the clergy who lose their slots become homeless.
revolutionary_republic.faith: No state faith for faith grievances: Wrong faith ends everywhere; Pious lords and clergy everywhere waver.
revolutionary_republic.tongue: Schools teach in the state language (culture design): the language mix moves twice as fast toward it.
revolutionary_republic.levy: The mass levy is open: every class can be called.
revolutionary_republic.abroad: Every monarchy: opinion -50; they gain a counter-revolution reason to fight you for 25 years.
revolutionary_republic.risk: Generals who grow too big (warfare 4.6) are twice as likely, and a winning one can end the republic.
revolutionary_republic.loop: You must run every province with officials and can arm the whole nation, while every king wants you gone.

free_republic.name: Free republic
free_republic.lords: Planters' land is taken by the state and given out as family farms.
free_republic.land: Everyone held in slavery is free. Plantation tiles stay state estates worked for wages, or are split into family farms (divide_the_estates): split tiles lose two thirds of their export wares and grow half again as much food.
free_republic.levy: The whole people defend the land: every farmer is a recruit for defensive wars.
free_republic.abroad: Slave-holding countries: opinion -60 and no trade pacts for 30 years; they may demand payment for recognition (an indemnity event).
free_republic.risk: Isolation: trade income halves while the old powers refuse to recognise you.
free_republic.loop: Freedom is defended with every farmer; the old export economy is gone and the world shuns you.

creole_republic.name: Republic of the landowners
creole_republic.lords: Big landowners stay as lords; commanders who win battles can become lords too.
creole_republic.abroad: The old crown: a reconquest reason for 15 years.
creole_republic.risk: A commander with a big army may seize the presidency (a pretender rising led by a general).
creole_republic.loop: The republic is held together by pacts with landowners and generals.

parliamentary_republic.name: Parliamentary republic
parliamentary_republic.lords: Titles lose their legal privileges; lords keep their land as private owners but no longer govern it (it needs your officials).
parliamentary_republic.land: Tax rates and war need an assembly vote; elections every few years can change the ruling party's priorities (AI personality shifts).
parliamentary_republic.trade: Public debt at the regime's low interest.
parliamentary_republic.risk: In a crisis (war lost, mass unemployment among craftsmen) extremist risings of left and right both grow.
parliamentary_republic.loop: Officials run the land the lords used to govern, and every big decision goes through the assembly.

committee_rule.name: Rule of the committee
committee_rule.lords: Kept, but army officers sit beside them.
committee_rule.tongue: The state language is pushed in schools and offices: the language mix moves faster toward it, Foreign rule grows in other homelands.
committee_rule.risk: Homelands of other languages raise separatist signs faster.
committee_rule.loop: Officers run the provinces and push one nation's language: strong in war, hard on minorities.

warlord_republic.name: Republic of the generals
warlord_republic.form_note: The form holds no lord weight, so every warlord is over the limit and slips (government 2.3): reunification is a fight against that drift.
warlord_republic.lords: Commanders holding armies in a province become lords of it (warlords). They keep its tax and recruits.
warlord_republic.abroad: Foreign powers may back a warlord (a hostile act).
warlord_republic.risk: Warlords make war on each other; a strong one may declare himself ruler.
warlord_republic.loop: The country is a map of generals: you reunite it by buying, beating or outlasting them.

secular_republic.name: Secular national republic
secular_republic.lords: Abolished; old titles have no legal force.
secular_republic.church: Religious courts and schools close; their judges and teachers become state officials or leave.
secular_republic.tongue: Script and school reform: literacy grows twice as fast for 20 years (culture design).
secular_republic.risk: Pious provinces resist: a faith rising sign for 20 years.
secular_republic.loop: A fast-modernising state built on schools and officials, with the devout provinces against you.

agrarian_reform.name: Land to the villages
agrarian_reform.lords: Lords lose their farm tiles; those go to the villages, which pay light tax and need no lord.
agrarian_reform.land: Village tiles: light tax that cannot be raised, Harsh lord ends, food +10 %. Export wares from estate tiles fall by a third.
agrarian_reform.abroad: Foreign owners of estates or mines: opinion -30.
agrarian_reform.risk: Landowners still holding estates fund risings for 20 years.
agrarian_reform.loop: Farmers are calm and fed, lords are weak, but the export money shrinks.

new_dynasty.name: New dynasty from the rising
new_dynasty.lords: Every lord starts Wavering. Lords who fought the rising lose their land.
new_dynasty.land: Tax is light everywhere for 10 years.
new_dynasty.abroad: Tributary overlords may demand recognition (subjects design).
new_dynasty.risk: The old dynasty's heirs are pretenders for 50 years.
new_dynasty.loop: You start again with a clean slate of grievances, but every lord and the old dynasty test you.

peasant_directorates.name: Peasant directorates
peasant_directorates.form_note: Directorate provinces are self-run (government 3.3) even though the form is not a kin or commune form.
peasant_directorates.lords: Kept elsewhere; in the risen provinces local directorates run affairs.
peasant_directorates.land: Risen provinces are run by a directorate: free, acts as a judge, tax light.
peasant_directorates.abroad: Neighbours who fear the movement get a reason to send troops 'to restore order' (an intervention hook).
peasant_directorates.risk: If the directorates are dissolved, every risen province gets Broken charter.
peasant_directorates.loop: Part of the realm runs itself: calm and cheap, outside your control.

emancipation.name: End of bondage
emancipation.lords: Lords' farm tiles lose a third of their workers' dues: lords' wealth -30 %.
emancipation.land: Farmers may leave for towns: overflow can move to neighbouring provinces' town slots.
emancipation.risk: Lords waver one step at once.
emancipation.loop: Towns and armies gain people; lords lose their hold on the land.

swarajya.name: Swarajya (self-rule)
swarajya.lords: No new land grants: ministers, officials and fort commanders are paid in gold, not land. A council of eight ministers are your officials.
swarajya.levy: Light cavalry and hill infantry; a fleet on the home coast.
swarajya.abroad: The empire it broke from: opinion -50 and a reason to fight for 30 years.
swarajya.risk: When the founder's line weakens, the chief minister's office turns hereditary and the generals' houses drift apart: the realm can become a confederation (form confederation).
swarajya.loop: Raid, don't hold: horsemen collect tribute from neighbours' provinces while hill forts keep your own, and paid officials keep the land the crown's.

khalsa_raj.name: Rule of the Khalsa
khalsa_raj.lords: Band chiefs keep land only while they and their horsemen serve in the army.
khalsa_raj.faith: Ministers and soldiers of every faith: no Wrong faith grievance anywhere, and persecution is locked.
khalsa_raj.levy: A standing army of drilled regiments and guns, trained by hired foreign officers, in place of band horsemen.
khalsa_raj.abroad: None at first; the company and empires on its borders watch its army.
khalsa_raj.risk: Everything rests on the ruler: at the ruler's death the army's regimental councils may rule and raise pretenders.
khalsa_raj.loop: A small realm with a modern army: drilled regiments cost far more than horsemen, and you pay for them by keeping every faith at peace.

misl_confederacy.name: Confederacy of the bands
misl_confederacy.lords: Each band's chief holds the land its horsemen won. The chiefs meet twice a year at the holy city and choose a war leader.
misl_confederacy.levy: Fast horsemen only; no siege trains.
misl_confederacy.risk: Bands fight each other when there is no common enemy: every 10 years without a war, a roll may make a chief Disloyal.
misl_confederacy.loop: Many chiefs and fast horsemen: cheap to run and hard to conquer, but no one can make them build or march far.

service_state.name: Service state
service_state.lords: Lords must serve: each gives a son as an official or a commander, or loses a province.
service_state.levy: Recruits are drawn by quota from every province (a fixed share), even lords' lands.
service_state.research: Foreign specialists cost half; one research branch of your choice is a third cheaper for 30 years.
service_state.risk: Old guards and clergy rise once (an old-order rising) within 10 years.
service_state.loop: Lords become your officers and officials; you catch up fast and the old guard resents it.

restoration_state.name: Restored central rule
restoration_state.lords: Lords' domains are abolished: their land becomes royal provinces and the lords get a pension (gold each year for 20 years).
restoration_state.levy: Conscription: every class can be levied; standing regiments are the norm.
restoration_state.research: Foreign specialists cost half; research one era behind the leader costs half.
restoration_state.risk: Former retainers of the lords rise once within 10 years (an old-order rising).
restoration_state.loop: You buy out the lords and run everything with officials, conscripts and borrowed knowledge.

military_kingdom.name: Age-regiment kingdom
military_kingdom.lords: Chiefs keep their land but their young men serve the king in age regiments.
military_kingdom.levy: Age regiments: a fixed share of young men serve for years; they may not marry while serving (births -10 %).
military_kingdom.risk: Long service with no war breeds discontent among the regiments.
military_kingdom.loop: A permanent, drilled army from the people, paid for in births.

regional_armies.name: Provincial armies
regional_armies.lords: Your governors (officials) may raise their own armies; each that does becomes a lord with a retinue.
regional_armies.risk: Strong governors grow into warlords if the centre weakens (warlord_republic follows a dynasty's fall).
regional_armies.loop: The dynasty survives by letting its governors arm, and slowly loses the provinces to them.

soviet_state.name: Council state
soviet_state.lords: Abolished, with their land: it goes to the farmers, later to collective farms.
soviet_state.church: Church land seized; houses of worship close one a year.
soviet_state.land: Farms belong to villages, then collectives: for 10 years food -20 %, then +10 %.
soviet_state.trade: Market folk slots halve; factories belong to the state.
soviet_state.levy: Every class can be levied; commissars sit beside commanders (desertion halved).
soviet_state.abroad: Every non-communist country: opinion -60; intervention reason for 5 years.
soviet_state.risk: Civil war against the old order for the first years; famine if grain is requisitioned in a failed harvest.
soviet_state.loop: Everything is run by the state through officials and councils; you can mobilise all of it, at the cost of hunger and isolation.

reaction.name: Reaction
reaction.lords: Loyal lords who fought for you gain one province each from the rebels' land.
reaction.risk: The signs come back: the revolution's need is one sign lower for 20 years.
reaction.loop: Order is back and the lords are pleased, but the ideas are only underground.

restored_monarchy.name: Restored monarchy
restored_monarchy.lords: Émigré lords return and get back half their old land; the rest stays with its new holders.
restored_monarchy.land: Church land that was sold stays sold.
restored_monarchy.abroad: Monarchies: opinion +30; the counter-revolution reason ends.
restored_monarchy.risk: If the restored ruler revokes the revolution's charters, the revolution can fire again.
restored_monarchy.loop: The crown is back, but the revolution's land sales and officials remain: a mixed realm.

call_the_faithful.name: Call the faithful
call_the_faithful.does: Raise a levy of every class of the state faith at twice the farmers' share, at once. They go home after one campaign season.

convert_by_decree.name: Convert by decree
convert_by_decree.does: Chaplains in the province work three times as fast for 10 years. Provinces of another faith get Wrong faith twice over while it runs.

appoint_emir.name: Appoint a governor
appoint_emir.limit: When a governor dies or is removed
appoint_emir.does: Choose a new governor (lord) for a returned province from your officials, commanders or a local family. The appointee starts Loyal.

sacred_treasury.name: Fill the sacred treasury
sacred_treasury.does: Every province sends its food above the people's need to the castle stores. No province can go Hungry while stores hold, but market folk lose work.

open_the_granaries.name: Open the granaries
open_the_granaries.does: Hand castle food to a province: Hungry ends there, and the province calms one step.

ask_the_towns.name: Ask the towns
ask_the_towns.does: Borrow from the towns at half the usual interest. Refusing their next request costs Broken charter in every town.

call_the_assembly.name: Call the assembly
call_the_assembly.does: Put a tax rise or a war of conquest to the assembly. It agrees when fewer than a third of provinces have grievances and the realm is not deep in debt; a yes gives the act without grievance penalties.

sell_bonds.name: Sell bonds
sell_bonds.does: Borrow from the public at the regime's low interest rate.

charter_a_company.name: Charter a company
charter_a_company.does: Found a trading company that buys ships and trading posts with merchant houses' money (company and trade designs).

army_council.name: Army council
army_council.does: Let the army decide a policy (war, peace, a purge): the act costs no stability, but generals gain influence and a coup grows more likely.

sell_church_lands.name: Sell church lands
sell_church_lands.does: Gold equal to ten years of the state church's tile income; church tiles pass to buyers (market folk and lords).

levy_en_masse.name: Levy of the whole nation
levy_en_masse.does: Every class can be levied at the farmers' share; the levy screen's caps double for one war.

revolutionary_tribunal.name: Revolutionary tribunal
revolutionary_tribunal.cost: Bloodshed in the provinces of those tried
revolutionary_tribunal.does: Try disloyal lords, officers or pretenders' backers: they are removed at once. Scholars may flee abroad.

arm_the_people.name: Arm the people
arm_the_people.does: Every farmer becomes a recruit for this war; they fight with locals-know-the-land bonuses in their own provinces.

divide_the_estates.name: Divide the estates
divide_the_estates.cost: The lord or owner of the tiles turns Disloyal
divide_the_estates.does: Split estate and plantation tiles into family farms: Harsh lord ends, food +, export wares -.

settle_the_frontier.name: Open the frontier
settle_the_frontier.cost: Indigenous homelands get Foreign rule and a resistance (province stats 12.3)
settle_the_frontier.does: Homeless and farmers may move to free tiles on the frontier as settlers at no cost. Shown with the harm it does to the people already there.

caudillos_pact.name: General's pact
caudillos_pact.does: Make a commander a lord over the provinces his army holds, in return for loyalty and his retinue in your wars.

summon_to_court.name: Summon to court
summon_to_court.cost: Gold for the court each year
summon_to_court.does: Call a lord to live at court: his retinue halves, his loyalty is fixed at Wavering or better while he stays.

intendants.name: Send an intendant
intendants.does: Place one of your officials in a lord's province as overseer: you get a quarter of its tax and the official's type effect.

censorship.name: Censorship
censorship.does: New ideas spread half as fast in your realm; presses and schools slow.

local_directorates.name: Recognise the directorates
local_directorates.does: Keep a directorate as the province's government: it acts as a free judge and keeps the province calm.

abolish_domains.name: Abolish the domains
abolish_domains.cost: Pensions: each lord's yearly income, for 20 years
abolish_domains.does: Every lord's land becomes royal land at once; lords become pensioners. Needs officials for every province.

missions_abroad.name: Missions abroad
missions_abroad.does: Send scholars to a leading country: the next three inventions you research that it already has cost half.

table_of_ranks.name: Ranks for service
table_of_ranks.does: Officials and commanders can earn a lordship by service; old lords must serve or lose a province.

call_the_age_regiment.name: Call an age regiment
call_the_age_regiment.limit: One age set at a time
call_the_age_regiment.does: Every young man of one age set joins a standing regiment, already trained.

officers_to_the_provinces.name: Officers to the provinces
officers_to_the_provinces.does: Make commanders officials: they run provinces as wardens or muster masters, at no wage.

buy_a_warlord.name: Buy a warlord
buy_a_warlord.does: A warlord accepts your rule: his provinces become royal and his men join your army.

requisition_grain.name: Requisition grain
requisition_grain.cost: Requisitioned grievance in every farming province
requisition_grain.does: Take a share of every village's harvest for the towns and the army.

script_and_schools.name: New script and schools
script_and_schools.does: Literacy grows twice as fast for 20 years; old religious schools close.

raise_provincial_army.name: Let a governor raise an army
raise_provincial_army.cost: The official becomes a lord with a retinue
raise_provincial_army.does: A governor raises troops from his province at his own cost to fight a rising or an invader.

gather_the_tribes.name: Gather a tribe at the capital
gather_the_tribes.cost: The province loses a third of its people; its lord's retinue moves with them
gather_the_tribes.does: Move a tribe's people to the capital: the capital grows and the tribe's lord serves at court, but the province empties and can go Hungry.

protection_tribute.name: Demand protection tribute
protection_tribute.does: Demand a share of a neighbour's province tax each year (a quarter for Maratha chauth, a fifth for Sikh rakhi) in return for not raiding it. If refused, your horsemen raid it: Burned homes there, loot for you.

garrison_hill_forts.name: Garrison the hill forts
garrison_hill_forts.cost: Gold for each fort's three officers
garrison_hill_forts.does: Forts in hill and mountain provinces build at half cost and hold sieges twice as long; each counts as a free judge for that province.

hire_drill_masters.name: Hire foreign drill masters
hire_drill_masters.cost: Gold each year; Proud lords waver
hire_drill_masters.does: Foreign officers train your regiments: new infantry and guns get the drill of the most advanced neighbour you trade with.
